text:
maria: Heads-up: enabling FP8 kernels on canary H100 and L40S showed a tiny but consistent perplexity bump on conv-model v2 during our eval suites.
kevin: can you paste the eval diff?
maria: short diff from run on canary vs baseline (FP16):
```
perplexity baseline: 12.84
perplexity fp8-canary: 13.02
avg token delta: 0.4%
```
liam: 0.4% isn't huge but consistent across prompts?
maria: yeah across ~3k prompts, concentrated on long-history prompts (>1024). also saw occasional token mispredictions early in sequence.
anya: did the canary use the new tiling memory layout patch?
maria: yes — we've enabled 'tile_opt_v2' in the kernel config to reduce scratch memory. disabling it drops the delta back to baseline.
kevin: oh interesting. could be tile->kvcache indexing off-by-one with packed fp8 layout.
liam: have we ruled out activation scaling differences? FP8 quant needs per-channel scale vs global.
maria: we tried both per-channel and per-tensor. per-channel improved but didn't fully close gap.
liam: can you run a single-example trace with debug flags for kv offsets?
maria: running now. log snippet:
```
[DEBUG] kv_offset[0]=0x7f8c2a
[DEBUG] kv_offset[1]=0x7f8c2b  <-- expected +0x1000 but +0x1
```
kevin: that's a red flag. looks like tiling arithmetic underflow when sequence_len%tile_size==1
anya: deploy-bot: started canary rollback for fp8-tile-opt on h100-canary-3 :rotating_light:
sre-bot: alert: regression detected on conv-model-v2, auto-fallback to FP16 path
maria: thanks. follow-ups:
- add unit test for sequence_len modulo tile size
- re-run quantized eval with GPTQ/AWQ variants to see if it's quant-specific
- check kernel fuse paths for mixed-precision math primitives
liam: I'll spin a micro-batch reproducer and try with fused vs unfused kernels. we should also compare against the old kernel packaging (pre-tile_opt).
kevin: check compiler flags: -funsafe-math maybe causes optimization reorderings that interact with tiny FP8 scales.
maria: note: when we forced mixed-precision fallback to FP16 for mats with small scale, perf dropped but perplexity matched baseline — so correctness tradeoff is clear.
anya: action: create a short eval job flagged 'fp8-tiling-investigation' next hour.
liam: will try GPTQ/AWQ quantization on same checkpoints. if GPTQ is stable maybe prefer it for now on L40S.
maria: thanks all, will paste reproducer and the failing batch once ready. :pray: 
kevin: nice triage. also add a short blurb to the release notes to avoid rolling fp8-wide until we have tests. :memo:
sre-bot: note: canary rollback complete.
maria: rolling follow-up PR with test + temp disable will land in ~2hrs.
kevin: ack.
